newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate sharply up on cenbank operation.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate sharply up on cenbank operation.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates soared 325 to close at 24.25 percent on Friday, on a liquidity shortfall intensified by higher long bond yields and central bank intervention, dealers said.
"Rates hit the roof when Banco de Mexico drained liquidity by assigning repos at above primary rates," a dealer said.
The central bank drained 3.378 billion pesos through three direct Cetes sales and five repos, one of which it assigned for three days at a rate of 23.89 percent.
U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds were up 65/32 to yield 6.45 percent in late dealing.
Liquidity also came under pressure from banks that had to settle balances outstanding on checking accounts they hold with the central bank by next Wednesday.
Overnight rates on bank paper rose 350 basis points to close at 24.50 percent.
Liquidity of 1.244 billion pesos was scheduled to return to the system from prior central bank participation.
